issues: 灰色骨架条冒充收件箱，标题之外没有可读内容，界面像占位图
纯黑场 + 冷白界面，光没有颜色也没有身份，读作一张圆形遮罩在放大
光前沿羽化过宽，整段像灰雾扩散，看不出"照到 / 照不到"的界线
全亮后只剩一张静止的平面界面，没有落点也没有余波
changes: look 换成 sand：光被重新解释为日出——光源在画外左上角，照亮晨间日程 app「Aubade」的今日简报（128px 问候、日出弧组件、四项日程含一块赤陶专注时段）
命门保留：显影平台半径严格 linear 190→2120，恰在 104f 盖满最远角；羽化带收窄到 110+0.3r，光前沿挂两圈 screen 杏粉辉边（宽 + 窄亮带）
光有色温：被照亮处先叠 multiply 晨光暖调，随时间褪成日光；角落几道极淡丁达尔光柱随光长、全亮后淡出
光到即醒：每块内容在光前沿扫过时上浮 18px 落座，按到光心距离自动错峰（左上先醒、右下后醒）
相机 1.12→1.0 缓出 112f 后静止；全亮 hold 46f 里太阳点沿日出弧升到 6:42、日晕极缓呼吸，尾帧是完整的晨间简报海报
issuesEn: Grey skeleton bars stood in for an inbox; apart from the title nothing was readable, so the UI looked like a placeholder
Pure black void plus a cold white UI: the light had no colour and no identity, reading as a circular mask scaling up
The light front was feathered so wide that it spread like grey fog, with no line between lit and unlit
Once fully lit it was just a static flat screen, with no landing beat and no follow-through
changesEn: Sand look: the light becomes a sunrise from off-frame top-left, revealing the morning brief of a planner app, Aubade (128px greeting, sunrise-arc widget, four agenda items including a terracotta focus block)

The core rule stays: the lit radius grows strictly linearly from 190 to 2120 and covers the farthest corner exactly at 104f; the feather is tightened to 110+0.3r and the front carries two screen-blended apricot rims (wide plus a thin bright band)
The light has colour temperature: newly lit areas start under a multiply dawn tint that fades to daylight, and faint god rays grow from the corner and fade once fully lit
Light wakes the content: each block rises 18px into place as the front passes it, auto-staggered by distance from the light (top-left first, bottom-right last)
Camera eases 1.12 to 1.0 over 112f then holds; during the 46f hold the sun dot climbs the arc to 6:42 and the corner glare breathes, so the last frame is a complete morning-brief poster
